Container.Name: Lineup
Container.Overview: Lineup is an application that fetches Electronic Program Guide (EPG) data from a HDHomeRun network TV tuner and converts it into XMLTV format — the standard format used by media servers like Jellyfin and Plex for TV guide display. It includes a web-based dashboard, a terminal UI, live TV streaming with transcoding, and automatic scheduled EPG fetching with smart incremental updates.

Config.Description: This is the Web UI port for the application.

Config.Description: Optional - Https webUI (you need to set up your own certificate).

Config.Name: Path: /xmltv
Config.Description: This is the container path to where the XMLTV file will be stored.
